items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: I think it's "Blues for Johnny." ... "One For Johnny," I think that's

ctx.x: Yeah, that's my tune. I wrote that, those tunes. I do one on here, I do a solo on here I like, on "Unbroken." I think it's "Blues for Johnny." I want you to listen to that. Play that tonight and I take a clarinet solo on that that I like.
